record.question: He is so poor that he cannot buy a pen.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. The “so … that” clause expresses result (B, adverb clause). Independent check: “That he cannot buy a pen” expresses the result of “so poor”; it is an adverbial result clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
